records.title: Trump says Iran probably responsible for attack on Saudi pipeline
records.claim: The Saudi East-West pipeline, a main crude-export route bypassing Hormuz, remained shut after an aerial attack; Trump said Iran was probably responsible.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Trump says Iran probably responsible for attack on Saudi pipeline

records.boundary: Attribution is a U.S. presidential assessment, not independently proven responsibility; the report does not establish duration or quantified export loss.

records.title: No signed Hormuz deal expected yet from Oman meeting on Monday, Iranian official says
records.claim: A senior Iranian official said Monday's Oman meeting was not expected to yield a signed Hormuz agreement; Iran still sought a framework allowing it to collect fees from ships using the strait.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: No signed Hormuz deal expected yet from Oman meeting on Monday, Iranian official says

records.boundary: This is a pre-meeting expectation from an unnamed senior Iranian official; final meeting outcomes may differ.

records.title: Houthi advance in Yemen puts U.S. in a new bind
records.claim: Houthi forces reached Perim island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, raising the risk that a second major regional energy and trade chokepoint could be constrained while Hormuz remains disrupted.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Houthi advance in Yemen puts U.S. in a new bind

records.boundary: Reaching Perim does not itself prove commercial closure of Bab el-Mandeb; actual vessel flows and shipowner decisions require separate verification.

records.title: Iran-Oman understanding does not provide for immediate reopening of Strait of Hormuz, Tasnim reports
records.claim: An Iranian source said the Iran-Oman understanding did not provide for immediate reopening of Hormuz and that reopening depended on U.S. acceptance of Tehran's conditions.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Iran-Oman understanding does not provide for immediate reopening of Strait of Hormuz, Tasnim reports

records.boundary: This is Reuters reporting of an Iranian source cited by semi-official Tasnim; it is not a published bilateral legal text.
